extension.description: Displays a list of users logged in with a link to their profile.

field.name: mode
field.label: Display Mode
field.description: Select the mode this module should display. Note User Count is a fast query approximation and may not reflect exact user numbers.

field.name: pretext
field.label: Pre-text
field.description: Input substitution supported html to display at the top of the module.

field.name: posttext
field.label: Post-text
field.description: Input substitution supported html to display at the bottom of the module.

field.name: usertext
field.label: User-text
field.description: Input substitution supported html to display for each user in the module. If left blank formatname field will be used.

field.name: limit
field.label: Limit
field.description: Set the maximum number of latest entries to display. Leave empty for no limit.

field.name: exclude
field.label: Exclude Users
field.description: Input a comma separated list of user ids to exclude from all modes.

field.name: exclude_self
field.label: Exclude Self
field.description: Choose if the viewing user should be excluded from display in all modes.

field.name: custom_field
field.label: Field
field.description: Select the CB field to order the latests list by.

field.name: label
field.label: Label Display
field.description: Select how to display counter labels.

field.name: separator
field.label: Thousands Separator
field.description: Set what character to use for separating counters in the thousands. Default comma.

field.name: maincbtpl
field.label: Load Template
field.description: Enable or disable loading of Community Builder template.

field.name: cb_plugins
field.label: CB Plugins integration
field.description: Choose if you want to use CB events for CB plugins integration. Plugins must be installed and configured in CB plugins management. Warning: this loads CB plugins on each page where this module is displayed, consuming memory and processing power.

field.name: userlist_listid
field.query: SELECT `listid` AS value, `title` AS text FROM `#__comprofiler_lists` ORDER BY `ordering` ASC
field.label: Userlist
field.description: Select the userlist to display. Note depending on module position this may or may not display nicely.

field.name: userlist_mode
field.label: List Display Mode
field.description: Select how to display this userlist. For example display only the search inputs.

field.name: userlist_hide
field.label: Auto Hide List
field.description: Choose if the module should hide if viewing the userlist this module displays. This avoids double rendering issues. Note this only works with menu items and URLs that explicitly supply the listid.

field.name: userlist_header
field.label: Hide List Title
field.description: Choose if the module should display the userlist title. This includes the user count and description.
